summary: Image clean-up can never remove anything your installation still runs or needs.

new.title: Clean-up keeps everything in use
new.text: What is kept is now decided from what your installation actually runs and needs. If anything is unclear, nothing is deleted and the next update tries again.

new.title: Clean-up reports what it does
new.text: The run log shows, as it happens, how many images exist, are kept and why, and are deleted. The totals also go to Audit.

new.title: Safe limits on each clean-up
new.text: At most 100 images per registry folder are deleted per update, and Invardia support can switch the clean-up off for your installation. It starts with the update after this version.
